body.technical_summary: Add a default parameter value and an early-return empty state to TodoList.jsx. Two lines added to the component. Add two regression tests to TodoList.test.jsx. No other files change.
implementation_plan: TodoList.jsx: change signature from ({ todos }) to ({ todos = [] }) to eliminate the undefined case
TodoList.jsx: add early return — if todos.length === 0, render the empty state paragraph
TodoList.test.jsx: promote the probe reproduction test to a permanent regression test; add a second case for todos=[]
assumptions: todos=[] default is sufficient — no caller needs to distinguish undefined from empty
No snapshot tests reference TodoList output that would require updating
design_notes: H-1 (default prop + early return) chosen over H-2 (parent guard) and H-3 (API normalisation) — it fixes the root cause at the component boundary with the smallest possible change and makes the component robust to any caller.
rollback_plan: Revert TodoList.jsx to previous version. No data or schema changes involved.

planned_changes.rationale: Add default value for todos prop and render empty state when list is empty
Promote probe reproduction test to permanent regression; add empty-array case

execution_handoff.code_change_summary: Modify TodoList.jsx to handle undefined/empty todos; add regression tests to TodoList.test.jsx
risk_areas: Any snapshot test that renders TodoList may now differ — check for __snapshots__ files in the component directory

test_scenarios.statement: Render TodoList with todos={undefined} — must show empty state, no error
test_scenarios.expected_result: Element with text 'No todos yet. Create your first one!' is present; no TypeError thrown

test_scenarios.statement: Render TodoList with todos={[]} — must show empty state, no error
test_scenarios.expected_result: Element with text 'No todos yet. Create your first one!' is present; no TypeError thrown

test_scenarios.statement: Render TodoList with a non-empty todos array — must render list items correctly
test_scenarios.expected_result: Todo items are rendered; empty state message is absent

test_commands.purpose: Run all TodoList tests including the two new regression tests
